thesis: The episode argues that investors are concerned Meta's massive capital expenditure on AI and the metaverse resembles past unprofitable metaverse investments, specifically citing Reality Labs as the biggest spend lacking results so far. While the market applauds AI spending at other hyperscalers due to clear monetization paths, the speaker suggests Meta's situation is viewed differently, though they disagree with the assessment that Meta lacks clear paths.
